summary: W19 — the added Build load week (Adj #204) and the last full week before the W20 deload. Mon's long is banked but under-filled: 60:00 ran against the 70-min ask (Adj #309), so the week lands ~24 mi and its entire easy fraction is ~14% short — no make-up, §11.D drops missed easy volume and no slot exists to repay it into. What ran was the best-quality long of the v4.4 era: every full mile inside the easy band at RPE 4, 10 s/mi quicker than W18 at a lower effort read, and the standing Achilles read at ~40 h off Saturday's calf 365 dose CLOSED CLEAN, so 365 holds Sat (Adj #310). The week's centerpiece is the §10 5K-pace cut-down Wed 8-26, which now arbitrates T alone: W18 validated the stepped 7:40–7:45 band (Adj #291) and settled I at 7:00–7:15 outright (Adj #296). Validity rests on hitting the M and T miles on pace before the goal-pace mile (Adj #292). Fri runs the 2nd exposure of 5×1000m @ I, opened at 7:00 with 90 s jog recoveries. Tuesday is banked and was the best accessory session of the Build: the rope pushdown's load drop to 47.5 produced the movement's first completed 4×12 and cleared the set-3 condition (Adj #315), and both the DB lateral and the Tue decline crunch met their gates — 40 and +15 fire W21 Tue, held past the W20 deload (Adj #313/#317). The preacher's 75 debut survived its revert guard (Adj #314). The incline stalled a second week at 160 (RIR 0, completed not missed, TM 168 stands) and its linear progression is called at its ceiling — Sharpen puts the lift on maintenance from W21 (Adj #312). Saturday still fires lat 170 and reverts the Sat DB lateral to 35.

days.note: Logged — 60:00 / 6.10 mi @ 9:49/mi + 0.43 mi / 4:02 jogged CD = 6.53 mi / 64:02. UNDER-FILLED: the work interval was set to 60:00 against the 70-min ask, ~10 min / ~1.0 mi short — dropped, not repaid (§11.D), W19 lands ~24 mi. Splits 9:24 / 9:27 / 9:46 / 10:20 / 10:16 / 9:46 + 0.54 mi @ 9:14/mi, RPE 4 — all six full miles inside the 9:15–10:30 band, fastest 9 s/mi clear of the fast edge, so the Adj #256/#283 pickup pattern stays closed. Ran 10 s/mi quicker than W18 at a lower effort read, HR 164 work avg (5 under W18), power 203 W, cadence 167–170 inside the easy allowance; CD jogged at 9:17/mi, the first jogged CD on a v4.4 long. Road, Vomero Plus; all clean by default — first run after the 8-22 calf 365 dose at ~40 h, the standing Achilles read CLOSED CLEAN, 365 holds W19 Sat (Adj #309/#310).

Logged — full §3.A dose on all six. Pushdown 47.5 on the rope: 12/12/12/12 RIR 3/3/1/0 = 48, the first completed 4×12 in the movement's history and the set-3 hold-until-clean condition met at last — the constraint was the load, not the tendon (Adj #315); hold 47.5, 50 on a repeat. DB lateral 35 × 12/12/12/12/13/12 RIR 3/3/3/3/0/0 = 73, gate met in full → 40 fires (Adj #313). Crunch +10 × 12/12/12 RIR 4/2/2 = 36, gate met on both terms → +15 fires (Adj #317). Both held to W21 Tue — W20 is a deload, §11.B takes no bumps. Preacher 75 debut survived its revert guard (10/10/10/6 RIR 2/1/0/0; front three held the floor) → hold and rebuild (Adj #314). Incline 160×5 RIR 0 + AMRAP 135×11 — completed not missed, TM 168 stands, but a second ≤RIR 1 read: e1RM ~185 a fourth straight time and 160 is ~98% of the predicted 5RM, so hold 160 and call the linear progression at its ceiling (Adj #312). Rear-delt 145 at RIR 1/0 vs last week's on-ask 3/3 — execution read, hold, stop at RIR 3 (Adj #318). All clean by default — elbow 16th consecutive clean session.
